question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To read between the lines
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"to read between the lines"** means:

 
 
• To understand or find the hidden meaning in something. (छिपे हुए अर्थ को समझना)
 
 
 
• **Example:** When you** read between the lines **of her letter, you can tell that she is not happy with the situation.

 
• **"To grasp the hidden meaning"** refers to understanding the underlying or implicit meaning that is not immediately obvious. (गुप्त अर्थ को समझना)

 
 
• **Example:** The detective was able **to grasp the hidden meaning** behind the suspect's words.
 
 

Therefore, the correct meaning of the given idiom is: **To grasp the hidden meaning.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To read aloud** (जोर से पढ़ना): To read something so that other people can hear you.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher asked the student to read aloud the passage from the book.
 
 
 
• **To whisper** (फुसफुसाना): To speak very softly using one's breath without using one's vocal cords.
 
 
• **Example:** She had to whisper the secret into her friend's ear.
 
 
 
• **To read without concentration** (ध्यान के बिना पढ़ना): To read something without paying full attention.
 
 
• **Example:** He was so distracted that he read the entire page without concentration.
 
 

44:Tadc,

The correct answer is **Option 3)**
